card.name: Just before amphetamine drug names
card.fires_on: Small words, commas or word starts right before 'amphetamine' or 'dextroamphetamine' in stimulant labels, such as 'such as', 'and', or 'dext' + 'ro'. Also a section number '5' in '5.5'.

modes.label: Linking words before amphetamine
modes.description: A comma, 'and', 'as' or 'the' that comes right before an amphetamine drug name in a list.

modes.label: Inside dextroamphetamine
modes.description: The 'ro' piece inside the name dextroamphetamine, just before 'amphetamine'.
modes.example: Discontinue treatment with dext<<ro>>amphetamine sulfate tablets and any concomitant

modes.label: Section number
modes.description: The digit 5 at the start of a cross-reference number in parentheses after a warning.

card.plain: It fires on little words and word parts that come right before an amphetamine name in stimulant drug labels.
